title: Screen Time Emerges as Top Obstacle to Student Success Worldwide
summary: McGraw Hill’s 2026 Global Education Insights Report: Human connection remains essential to learning amid growing educator concerns about the impact of technology on students Key Findings: Screen time is now the biggest obstacle to student success worldwide, and 42% of educators say students’ ability to focus has declined compared to five years ago. 68% of educators are concerned about their students' mental well-being, while managing student behavior and mental health remains the top challenge for educators for the second year in a row. Despite growing AI usage, 72% of educators do not expect in-person instructional time to decline over the next decade. AI is saving educators time, but trust remains conditional: Educators are 81% more likely to completely trust AI embedded in education platforms than general GenAI chatbots, with trust in general chatbots declining 33% vs. last year.
